summary: Task/route grouping: cluster nearby tasks or bias routes by zone/proximity.
businessRules: grouping defines: Set grouping rules for the tasks and routes. * Use order_grouping to group nearby tasks * Use route_grouping to control route sequencing.
Must stay consistent with: options.grouping.order_grouping, options.grouping.route_grouping, options.grouping.proximity_factor. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
